import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Parse body_mass_g from text to numeric
    df["body_mass_g"] = pd.to_numeric(df["body_mass_g"].str.replace(r'\s|,|\$', '', regex=True), errors='coerce')
    # Convert year to datetime (or at least ensure it's numeric and valid)
    df["year"] = pd.to_datetime(df["year"], errors='coerce').dt.year
    # Fix negative flipper_length_mm to NaN
    df.loc[df["flipper_length_mm"] < 170, "flipper_length_mm"] = None
    # Filter out of range flipper_length_mm
    df = df[(df["flipper_length_mm"] >= 170) & (df["flipper_length_mm"] <= 235)]
    # Filter out of range body_mass_g
    df = df[(df["body_mass_g"] >= 2500) & (df["body_mass_g"] <= 6500)]
    # Normalize species labels to canonical form (Adelie, Chinstrap, Gentoo)
    species_map = {"Adelie": "Adelie", "Adelie ": "Adelie", "adelie": "Adelie",
                    "Gentoo": "Gentoo", "Gentoo ": "Gentoo", "gentoo": "Gentoo",
                    "Gentto": "Gentoo",
                    "Chinstrap": "Chinstrap", "Chinstrap ": "Chinstrap", "chinstrap": "Chinstrap"}
    df["species"] = df["species"].map(species_map).where(df["species"].isin(["Adelie", "Chinstrap", "Gentoo"]), None)
    # Drop rows where species is now missing
    df = df.dropna(subset=["species"])
    # Keep only id column intact (penguin_id)
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by species, compute mean flipper_length_mm
    grouped = df.groupby("species").mean()
    result = {}
    for label, row in grouped["flipper_length_mm"].to_frame().iteritems():
        # If group label is not in allowed set, skip
        if label not in ["Adelie", "Chinstrap", "Gentoo"]:
            continue
        result[label] = round(row["flipper_length_mm"], 1) if not pd.isna(row["flipper_length_mm"])
        else None
    # If all species present, add 'all' key
    if set([k for k in result if not pd.isna(result[k])]) == set(["Adelie", "Chinstrap", "Gentoo"]):
        all_val = df[df["species"].isin(["Adelie", "Chinstrap", "Gentoo"])]["flipper_length_mm"].mean()
        if not pd.isna(all_val):
            result["all"] = round(all_val, 1)
    # Remove keys with NaN values
    result = {k: v for k, v in result.items() if not pd.isna(v)}
    return result
